Starting from iOS 26.4, Apple has supported conversational apps on CarPlay.

This category includes AI chatbot apps. Siri AI will be added to CarPlay starting from iOS 27. The iPhone software update is currently in beta and will be officially released in September.

Meanwhile, the fourth third-party AI chatbot, Meta AI, has officially added support for Apple CarPlay.

The Meta AI iPhone app is now available on Apple CarPlay — but there is one thing to note

The latest version of the Meta AI iPhone app now supports CarPlay.

The Meta AI app joins three other third-party chatbot apps that already support CarPlay, including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Grok.

However, Meta AI's support on CarPlay still appears to be in a limited testing phase for now.

Although the iPhone app will appear on CarPlay, launching it may currently display a "not supported" message.

In my personal case, when launching the app on CarPlay, the screen displayed "Your account is not currently supported for the Meta AI experience."

I tried using a paid Meta AI account to see whether CarPlay support is limited to paid accounts only. However, the message in the Meta AI CarPlay app did not change. The actual experience may vary from person to person.

Regardless, it's encouraging to see a fourth mainstream chatbot app appear on CarPlay before Siri AI is officially rolled out to everyone.

This is precisely CarPlay's core strength: seamlessly integrating your existing iPhone apps into your car. Built-in infotainment systems simply cannot offer such a rich variety of choices.

Earlier this month, Meta AI also arrived on Mac. The desktop version is far more powerful than the iPhone and iPad versions.
